description: Implementation class for CriteriaFactory interface, providing factory methods for creating various query criteria and predicates in a query building framework.

classes.name: CriteriaFactoryImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing CriteriaFactory to generate different criteria and predicate objects for building queries.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns an instance representing a criterion that matches any criteria.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates an 'AND' composite criteria from a list of criteria.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates an 'OR' composite criteria from a list of criteria.

methods.name: nor
methods.description: Creates a 'NOR' criteria from a list of criteria.

methods.name: fieldCriteria
methods.description: Creates criteria based on a field expression and a predicate.

methods.name: existsCriteria
methods.description: Creates criteria that check for the existence of a field.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates an equality predicate for a given value.

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a non-equality predicate for a given value.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a 'greater than or equal to' predicate.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a 'less than or equal to' predicate.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a 'like' predicate; only applicable for string values.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates an 'in' predicate for checking if a value is within a list.
